scope: Read-only local data and source audit; only this diagnostic JSON is written; no model, tokenizer, simulator, unseen evaluation, training, source edit, or remote access.
conclusion: No detected cross-arm data-format or task-string confound. The observed negative screen remains a valid outcome of the frozen treatment comparison within the audited scope. Changed causal histories are intended trajectory changes, not evidence of stale/counterfactual observations.

training_consumption.mechanism: gnrl.train_sft.load_examples resets history for every trajectory and appends only that row's earlier observation/action pairs. gnrl.policy.messages uses an explicit causal allowlist. Selection metadata, privileged states and future observations do not enter the prompt.

original_goal_interpretation.contract: Typed existential original benchmark/PDDL goal; alternative object/receptacle/device assignments and terminal states are allowed under the frozen contract. This is not an identical-terminal-state intervention.
original_goal_interpretation.source_validation: parse_goal checks full supported typed existential goal against original metadata. execute_recipe records fresh actual transitions for every action; replay_own_trace separately resets and compares every causal field and state to the candidate's own discovery trace. validate_successful_pool checks original problem/metadata hashes, canonical source bytes and original-goal witness.

limitations: Original native120 lines, all60 pool hashes, embedded original PDDL/metadata and every retained candidate source are independently checked from locally copied artifacts. Original server game files are not reopened; goal/source provenance remains hash-bound to those acquisition artifacts.

No simulator replay was rerun. Actual execution provenance is the existing digest-bound replay evidence and reviewed replay implementation; local chain checks cannot independently prove physical execution.
No tokenizer/model was loaded. Token-level scorer/SFT consistency and truncation evidence are inherited from the existing hash-matched token audit, not newly recomputed.
train_sft.py is locally inspected and hashed; its run-time deployment hash is not part of selection adoption receipt and is not independently checked in this diagnosis.

Absence of a data-format confound does not establish the mechanism of performance decline, statistical generality, or any downstream improvement. No failed outcomes, comparison settings, or gates are changed.
